A sensational way to end the innings and this is MI's fifth straight win this year. This is 
also the 150th victory for MI in the IPL, the first time for any team in the league. And it's

7.25pm The first time, MI have beaten LSG in a league game. The head to head record 
was 6-1 heading into this game in LSG's favour, and that one win came in a knockout 
game. So, a lot of records being broken. All smiles in the MI camp and why not! This 
was in a lot of ways, a complete game for MI, who have turned around the season quite 
spectacularly as they win the game by 54 runs on a day where close to 19,000 kids have 
turned up through MI's ESA programme. There were plenty of heroes for the home 
team. Rickelton and Suryakumar with fifties, Boult with his three wickets, Bumrah with 
his four-for and Bosch for his all-round show. LSG started well with Marsh and Pooran 
striking well but MI came back strongly. The win takes them to second on the points 
table, though they have played an extra game. 
Rishabh Pant: [Bowling first] It was the right decision for us, we back our batting. We 
want to give the bowlers the best conditions, but today was not our day. The other team 
is also playing good cricket, and you have to give them credit instead of questioning 
ourselves. But we can figure it out because we have a break. [Batting at No. 4] I am not 
thinking about it too much. In a season like this you can start questioning yourself and I 
don't want to do that. Every time you take out that induvial is not the right thing to do. 
[On Mayank] It was good to see him coming back. He is getting into his rhythm. Hopeful 
he becomes better and better 
Bosch: [Debut] I officially got the news first thing in the morning through Mahela. Super 
happy about it. It's a super special feeling for me. It is my brother's birthday and what a 
special day to make my MI debut. [Thought while batting] It was just about contacting 
bat with ball. My nerves were through the roof, I just wanted to make contact with the 
ball. [Bowling] I have put in quite a lot of work. And here at MI as well, they are helping 
me a lot. [Preferred batting position] I am just happy to bat wherever the team needs 
me. I am willing to bat and contribute to the team. So proud and happy and privileged to 
be part of such an important day. 
Tcj: "Boult, Bumrah and Bosch (BBB) combined to take 8/68 off 12 overs." 
Abhishek Jakhad: "Posting this comment again. Bosch seems to strengthen MI more 
than Santner, inspite of variety that Santner brings, simply because its underlines the MI 
philosophy. A fast bowling allrounder complimenting another fast bowling all rounder. 
Can Bosch and Hardik can emulate the camaraderie of Hardik and Polly?" 
Kasinathan: "Not taking away anything from Boom and Boult it is threat two wicket over 
from Jacks that tilted the match in MI's way" 
Presentation time 
Hardik Pandya, the MI captain: The momentum which we had and carrying that 
momentum and everyone has been chipping. Everyone kept taking the chances. At the 
end it looked like we have lost of a few wickets. But Bosch and Naman came in and 
chipped in. We knew when to kill the game and we were awesome. The good teams are 
made of that when everyone comes in and chips in. [Bowling one over] Whenever it is 
required I bowl. Today I thought it was a great chance for Bosch to come in and bowl. 
[Five in a row] This competition is very tough and we can't afford to get carried away. 
We will always look forward to play good cricket and always look at the next game 
Will Jacks is the player of the match: I am a batter who bowls but my bowling is very 
important. [Part-time bowler?] I work very hard on my bowling. I know I am not a part-
timer; I don't care what everyone else says. [Two wickets in an over] We know how 
important Pooran and Pant are. Offspinners to left-handers are important and glad we 
got the two wickets. [Revival] I have really enjoyed my time here. They have been very 
welcoming. Everyone has given me utmost confidence to be part of the team. We have 
to continue the good work. [On Bumrah] He is an extremely good bowler. I have had the 
displeasure to face him in the nets and it not a good feeling. I am very happy to be on 
the same team as him. 
An incredible turnaround for MI, who after winning one in five games, have now won five 
in five and looking the team to beat. LSG, well, they have some time on their hand and 
need to go back to the drawing board. If you missed any of the action, Ekanth's report
